evidence_commit: Commit containing this proposal; exact SHA in task handoff.
objective: One explicit Settings launch and assertion/screenshot baseline; metadata can only advance to root visual review.
flow:
appId: com.apple.Preferences
---
- extendedWaitUntil:
    visible: "Settings"
    timeout: 5000
- takeScreenshot: "settings-probe-1"
approval_status: No P4 execution approval received. Prior allowances consumed.
preflight: Exact frozen manifest/files, audited installed JARs/launcher and Xcode metadata.
Fresh output absent; exact retained target initially Shutdown; older targets Shutdown.
At least 20 GiB free before boot and flow; fresh device/capacity observations required in approved run.
Idle ports7999/8000/8001, exact SpringBoard/parent identity, no unexpected TableUs.
Before external launch reserve30s launch+5s host+240s flow within420s total/60s final cleanup reserve.
review_gate: One registered invocation with exact device/flow path/hash; records do not predate registration.
Exact four completed command records; no Maestro launch/permission/clear command.
Canonical bounded XCTest log contains completed Preferences snapshot wholly inside title assertion.
Permission audit logs retained with hashes; observed permission-operation markers fail.
Hashed PNG retained; successful driver result is pending_visual_review with acceptance:false.
Astra inspects bound PNG for Settings title and substantive content. Blank/transition-only UI fails visual baseline.
cleanup: Snapshot before child stop; exact-owned group/collectors within flow cleanup budget; Settings termination and verified target shutdown; confirm Shutdown/idle ports/absent known target, Settings and runner PIDs. Unknown cleanup fails; retain device data and artifacts.
stop: First preflight, command, monitored crash/identity, startup, permission-marker, evidence or capacity failure; interruption/deadline. No retry or downstream continuation.

static_initialization_review.method: javap -c -p on installed JARs, no Maestro CLI or native invocation

paths.finding: No implicit target launch/permissions/clear operations in inspected method.
Config/JS/AndroidChromeDevTools/listeners and commands; no implicit target launch, permission, app-state clear or keychain-clear calls found.
Returns false directly; no target mutation.
Constructs LocalXCTestInstaller, XCTestDriverClient, XCTestIOSDevice, IOSDriver then Maestro.Companion.ios.
Auxiliary XCTest runner start/restart and conditional uninstall when reinstallDriver=true; no inspected target Preferences permission/clear/launch call.
Delegates hierarchy request without appId. Assertion-only flow relies on already displayed UI; it does not set Preferences as an explicit hierarchy target.
No appId field in request. XCTestIOSDevice has deviceId/client/getInstalledApps fields and no configured target appId. activeAppId used in gesture paths, not this hierarchy request.

limits: Static selected-callpath review, not a blanket proof of all native side effects.
Auxiliary XCTest initialization is part of any Maestro session and can still fail.
Prior Settings permission states are unknown; no reset/revoke authorized.
No native execution or compatibility/visual acceptance claimed.
Native XCTest exact hierarchy selection was not inspected. Expected-app hierarchy and root PNG gates are required; external launch ordering is not a proven rendering fix.

synthetic_integration.meaning: File/metadata integration only. Synthetic PNG is header-only and no visual acceptance is granted.

checks.sandbox_failure: Local fault-proxy listener 127.0.0.1:18981 denied with EPERM. Retained and rerun with loopback permission; no source change.
checks.source_gate: Read-only exact source gate checked in both preparation and durable archive; native main not called.
checks.review: Sol implementation/mocks; Luna static bytecode extraction; Astra review, corrections, audited checks and archive integration.

not_included: permission reset/revoke or intentional Settings permission configuration
limitations: Changed launch ordering is diagnostic, not a proven fix; original blank-image cause remains unresolved.
Java hierarchy request has no appId; native selection unverified. Expected-app and visual gates remain required.
Maestro setup starts/restarts auxiliary XCTest; assertion-only does not mean no infrastructure side effects.
No permission baseline was retained in P3-R1. No claim individual permission states are unchanged.
Monitor covers known platform/app/startup failures, not every system-service crash.
A passed Settings baseline does not validate TableUs, clear prior app/platform failures, or reopen later budgets.
